name: Nisko County (Poland)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the county arms of Nisko: a shield with red and white pales and a yellow crown above a fir tree on blue.
history: Polish county (powiat) and city flags are established by resolution of the council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.
